author: SergiHo
body: I can 100% CONFIRM the auto-complete BUG.  My town morale has ALWAYS been 100%.  Then suddenly it was at 19%, even after completing almost ALL jobs whenever available.  But if I click \[Complete Quest\] ONE at a time, I get the full credit.  As soon as I figured it out, my town morale is back to 100%, where it should be.
